edits.old: - **Fleet status**: not landed. Today read `bun repo leases status`, `bun repo capacity status`, `bun repo session list` and `bun repo doctor`.
edits.new: - **Fleet status**: `bun repo fleet status` (`--json`, `--limit=<n>`; MCP tool `fleet_status`) is one read-only picture in under a second without a lease or a graph: who runs what (phase, counter, time left, age, priority, code freshness, memory admitted against really used), every queue with a waiting-time estimate, Bazel servers, storage against its budgets, sealed implementation, graph generation and findings (stuck holders, pressure, long waits, low disk). Start here, then `bun repo leases status` or `bun repo capacity status` for detail.

Hier anfangen, danach `bun repo leases status` oder `bun repo capacity status` für Einzelheiten.

edits.anchor: | `bun repo doctor` | one-shot answer for waiting, slow or failing work (pins, images, leases, grants, generations); `--fix --dry-run` lists the safe repairs |
edits.block: | `bun repo fleet status [--json]` | the whole picture in one read-only screen (about 0.4-0.5 s, 93 MB, no lease, no graph): a source that fails or hangs names itself and leaves out only its own section; a run started before the standing-record format shows `code unknown`; waiting-time estimates are printed only where earlier holds taught one |
